presidency_create_period_description: Every transaction belongs to a period based on its date. The period sets the monthly fee and the late fee.
presidency_delete_period_description: It has no transactions, so it will be deleted permanently. This action can't be undone.
presidency_period_due_day_description: Fees paid after this day of the month get a late fee. Between 1 and 28.
presidency_period_in_use_description: Changes to the fee, the late fee or the due day only apply to fees recorded from now on.
presidency_period_search_hint: Search by period name, for example "2026"
presidency_periods_empty: No periods. Create one to start recording transactions.
presidency_create_amenity_description: A common area houses can book by the day, for example "Terrace" or "Pool".
presidency_delete_amenity_description: It has no reservations, so it will be deleted permanently. This action can't be undone.
presidency_amenity_name_description: How it will appear in reservations and in "Treasury".
presidency_amenity_default_fee_descripti: Suggested when booking and can be changed on each reservation. 0 if the area is free.
presidency_amenity_deactivated_descripti: {name} will no longer appear when booking
presidency_amenities_empty: No common areas. Add the terrace, the pool or any area that can be booked.
presidency_create_reservation_descriptio: Each area is booked for a full day and only one house can use it per day. If it has a fee, the charge stays pending for the treasurer.
presidency_reservation_paid_description: The payment is already in "Treasury", so the area, the house and the amount can't be changed. You can move the date.

match.countPlural=one: Owes 1 month: {months}. You can book anyway.
match.countPlural=other: Owes {count} months: {months}. You can book anyway.

presidency_reservation_date_description: Days when the area is already booked are disabled.
presidency_add_fee_description: Turn it on if the reservation has a charge, like the area fee or electricity for bounce houses or inflatables.
presidency_fee_description: Paid in full when booking. You can write the reason for the charge in "Notes".
presidency_reservation_notes_description: Optional. Reason, schedule, or any agreement with the house.
presidency_reservation_search_hint: Search by house number or notes
presidency_reservations_empty_no_ameniti: No reservations. Add an area in "Common areas" to start booking.
presidency_delete_reservation_descriptio: {summary}. The day will be free for another house. This action can't be undone.
presidency_cancel_reservation_descriptio: {summary}, paid with {amount}. The day will be free for another house. The income stays in "Treasury" and any refund is recorded as an expense.
presidency_refund_description: What is returned to the house. 0 if there's no refund.
presidency_refund_max: The refund can't be more than {amount}
presidency_transfer_reference_descriptio: Bank tracking key or reference number.
presidency_refund_notes_description: Optional. Saved on the expense in "Treasury".
presidency_pay_reservation_description: {summary} - {amount}. It will be recorded as income in "Treasury" and the reservation will become "Paid".
presidency_folio_description: The number on the receipt handed out.
presidency_payment_notes_description: Optional. Saved on the transaction in "Treasury".
presidency_reference_required: A reference is required for transfers
presidency_error_amenity_name_taken: An area with that name already exists
presidency_error_create_amenity: Couldn't create the area, please try again
presidency_error_update_amenity: Couldn't update the area, please try again
presidency_error_delete_amenity: Couldn't delete the area, please try again
presidency_error_amenity_in_use: Can't delete: the area has reservations. Deactivate it instead.
presidency_error_reservation_paid_cancel: The reservation is already paid. The treasurer can cancel it and record the refund.
presidency_error_reservation_paid_locked: The reservation is already paid: the area, the house and the amount can't be changed
presidency_error_day_taken: The area is already booked that day
presidency_error_already_paid: This reservation already has its payment recorded
presidency_error_no_cost: This reservation is free, there's nothing to collect
presidency_error_refund_exceeds: The refund can't be more than what was paid
presidency_error_create_reservation: Couldn't record the reservation, please try again
presidency_error_update_reservation: Couldn't update the reservation, please try again
presidency_error_cancel_reservation: Couldn't cancel the reservation, please try again
presidency_error_record_payment: Couldn't record the payment, please try again
